title: Block 4: Refactor the Worker Execution Engine to strictly spawn hyper
description: Refactor the Worker Execution Engine to strictly spawn hyperspecialized agents for MICRO tasks. [Acceptance Criteria: Execution loop blocks any 'generalist' prompts, dynamically selects specialized roles (e.g., 'ColorSpecialist', 'TypographyExpert') based on the node's focus, and limits the agent's context strictly to its target atom and immediate parent pointer.]
